QuestInfo.name: [Kerning Tower] Hiring a Makeup Artist
QuestInfo.0: You agree to hire a top makeup artist for the debut of Jackpot Entertainment's new group. Go find #bRicardo Ricotta#k at the #r5F Cosmetics Shops#k.
QuestInfo.1: #i4036024:# #t4036024:# items simulate the appearance of perfect skin. Gather #b15#k #b#i4036024:# #t4036024:##k items, then take them to Ricardo Ricotta. #r#o4310011##k and #r#o4310012##k in the area should have them.
QuestInfo.2: You took #b15#k #b#i4036024:# #t4036024:##k items to Ricardo Ricotta and hired him for the debut. All that remains is the hairstylist.

0.msg: Hi, my name's #h0#, and I'm here on behalf of a new music group from Jackpot Entertainment. How would you like the opportunity to have your work featured on Kerning City Superstars?

1.msg: Hmph! You speak to the magnificent Ricotta! My work has appeared on those broadcasts many times! I always relish the opportunity to work with a new face. I would be happy to make your singers beautiful! ...On one condition.

2.msg: Ricotta does not put his name on anything short of magnificence! In order to do an exquisite job on their makeup, I'll need some #b#i4036024:# #t4036024:#s#k. Bring me some, and you have a deal.

yes.0: How many are in your group? Five? Well, then I'll need precisely #b15#k #b#i4036024:# #t4036024:##k items.
yes.1: You should be able to acquire them from those dreadful #r#o4310011##k and #r#o4310012##k monsters nearby.

no.0: Then no deal! For Ricotta to work his magic, he uses only #b#i4036024:# #t4036024:#s#k in his work!

1.0: Ah, #b15#k #b#i4036024:# #t4036024:##k items, just like I asked. Now I can turn their faces into works of art!

yes.0: That's exactly the right amount. Excellent. Ricotta knows the time and the place! He will see you at the debut, and your girls will be gorgeous! You have Ricotta's word.
yes.1: Hmm...? Did you hear that? It sounded like a guitar... How strange.

default.0: I'll need around #b15#k #b#i4036024:# #t4036024:##k items. You can get them from #r#o4310011##k and #r#o4310012##k in the area.
